description: This file defines interfaces, structures, and functions for managing Multiple Masters and GX variable fonts in the FreeType project. It includes structures for axes, styles, and font variations, as well as functions to retrieve and set design coordinates for font interpolation.

methods.name: FT_Get_Multi_Master
methods.description: Retrieves the Multiple Master descriptor of a given font.

methods.name: FT_Get_MM_Var
methods.description: Retrieves the Multiple Master / GX variable descriptor of a font.

methods.name: FT_Set_MM_Design_Coordinates
methods.description: Sets the design coordinates for a Multiple Masters font.

methods.name: FT_Set_Var_Design_Coordinates
methods.description: Sets the design coordinates for a variable font (MM or GX).

methods.name: FT_Set_MM_Blend_Coordinates
methods.description: Sets normalized blend coordinates for MM and GX fonts.
